LESSON: PHONOLOGICAL AWARENESS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.3: Phonological Awareness
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Phonological Awareness, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 4 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: Why is correct pronunciation of words important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. look at pictures of household items and combine the syllables given to form words and say them aloud with peers,

2. listen to an audio recording related to house rooms and household items then repeat the vocabulary (e.g. 厨房、客厅、 卧室、桌子、厕所、椅子、床、电视、 冰箱),

3. say the location of household items(椅 子、桌子、床、 电视、冰箱) in relation to house rooms using prepositions of location or position(在、上、下),

4. take turns to ask and respond to questions on the location of household items (e.g. 电视在哪儿? 电视在桌子 上。),

5. sing a song on household items and rooms using the correct pronunciation,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. look at pictures of household items and combine the syllables given to form words and say them aloud with peers,
2. listen to an audio recording related to house rooms and household items then repeat the vocabulary (e.g. 厨房、客厅、 卧室、桌子、厕所、椅子、床、电视、 冰箱),
3. say the location of household items(椅 子、桌子、床、 电视、冰箱) in relation to house rooms using prepositions of location or position(在、上、下),
4. take turns to ask and respond to questions on the location of household items (e.g. 电视在哪儿? 电视在桌子 上。),
5. sing a song on household items and rooms using the correct pronunciation,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Phonological Awareness together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Self-efficacy is exhibited as the learner identifies household items and rooms with the appropriate vocabulary.

Values:
• Respect: The learner appreciates the diverse opinions of their peers when they take turns in saying the location of household

items.

• Responsibility: This is nurtured as the learner observes safety precautions when discussing the appropriate placement of the

various household items.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Safety: There is awareness on home safety when the learner discusses the importance of placing household items in their

appropriate places.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to link their learning to Agriculture on the concept of order and safety at home.
